youtube.title: Aankh masalne par taare kyun dikhte hain? ✨ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aankhein band karke unhe masalte hain to rang aur chingariyan dikhti hain. Lekin wahan to koi roshni hoti hi nahi.

Aankh ke light sensors sirf roshni se nahi, dabav se bhi trigger ho jaate hain. Jab aap dabate ho, to wo fire ho jaate hain aur dimaag ise roshni samajh leta hai. In chingariyon ka naam hai phosphenes.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
